notes:
Short summary: POC kicked off strong (reranking + embeddings for freight matching) but stalled after security review and an internal hiring freeze. Engineering lead pulled off the project Nov 2025 — no cycles since. Competitive pressure from ModelServeCorp (they offered an on-prem sandbox) and an internal budget reprioritization put deal on hold. Key quote from Head of Product (11/18): "We like performance but we have zero bandwidth until Q3; security wants audited KMS and explicit residency guarantees."

POC details: lightweight end-to-end test created by our SE; baseline latency targets 60ms p95 for rerank calls, throughput 150 req/s in peak simulations. Initial integration used our Dedicated preview in their VPC; ran into audit gaps (missing artifact-level logging + retention policy mismatch). POC milestone 2 (live traffic shadowing) missed on 2025-12-08 — no engineering resource to wire traffic. Security asked for completed answers to SOC2/ISO questions and a legal review of data residency (response submitted 2026-02-10).

Why stalled: combination of budget freeze for Q1 hiring, security policy items (audit/logging + KMS), and departure of internal champion (Sr. ML Eng left Dec). They also asked for an air-gapped option; that is high touch and would push cost beyond their current commit. Our commercial offer was softened (extended evaluation) but procurement is on hold.

Notes on engagement: AE (Maya) raised exec sponsor in Dec; CISO requested architecture diagram + signed NDA (provided). SE follow-ups slowed after Dec due to no engineering time. Recent outreach Feb 2026 got lukewarm reply: "Still on hold — we will revisit after budget planning."

Suggested comeback: provide a 4-week limited private trial with pre-packaged security artifacts (KMS integration guide, audit log config, residency options) and a simplified POC plan that requires only a 1-day engineering touchpoint. Offer a price-protected pilot credit to keep them engaged.
